title: Grateful Dead Live at Philadelphia Civic Center on 1984-04-21
source: Source: AUD FOB 2 Beyer 160s->sony TCD5M->Sony CDR-W66->EAC->cdwave->CD

ai_review.summary: Highly praised audience recording hailed as the best source for this beloved show
ai_review.review: The reviewer loves the performance and considers this the best available source, though they plan to patch the drum and DNL tracks with a Neuman tape, hinting at minor balance issues. Overall the show is regarded positively and the audience capture is deemed good.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review expresses strong enthusiasm for both performance and recording, but limited data prevents a higher confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it the best source yet mentions patching DNL and drums with a Neuman tape, indicating slight balance or noise‑level concerns.
